description: Implementation of ProductPriceService interface, providing business logic for handling product prices, including adding descriptions, saving, updating, and deleting ProductPrice entities within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductPriceServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class that manages ProductPrice entities, extending the generic SalesManagerEntityServiceImpl and implementing the ProductPriceService interface.

methods.name: ProductPriceServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ProductPriceDao dependency.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a ProductPrice and updates the entity.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing ProductPrice, handling associated descriptions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a ProductPrice after re-fetching it to avoid detached entity issues.
